commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; echo "RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID"; echo "ATTEMPT=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; echo "REPO=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"; git branch --show-current; git status --short | head

DEVFLOW_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/preflight.py ignore-precondition --path "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1243.md" && echo "IGNORED-ok" || echo "exit=$?"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body
gh issue view 1243 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1243.md
wc -c .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1243.md
head -c 60 .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1243.md

MARKER=".prflow/tmp/implement-active-1243"
if [ -n "${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID" > "$MARKER"; else : > "$MARKER"; fi
ls -la "$MARKER"

grep -rln "verification_flight\|_PROFILE_REQUIRED\|_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED\|_validate_checkout" lib/test/ scripts/ lib/ | sort -u
echo "=== any schema<->helper profile coupling test ==="
grep -rn "verification_flight" lib/test/*.py lib/test/modules/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head

cat > .prflow/tmp/plan-1243.md <<'EOF'
- [ ] AC1: new producer `scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py` (exec bit + shebang, direct leading token) emitting the 5-field checkout fingerprint via git plumbing; each field's derivation documented once in its header (checkout_id=absolute-git-dir; head=rev-parse HEAD; index_digest=write-tree; tracked_digest=write-tree of temp index after add -u; untracked_digest=write-tree of empty temp index + untracked files)
- [ ] AC2: tighten `_validate_checkout` — head/i …[per-command-truncated]

python3 scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- non-git dir ---"
cd /tmp 2>/dev/null; python3 /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py; echo "rc=$?"

python3 scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py > .prflow/tmp/ckout-final.json 2>/dev/null || echo FAILED
python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); import reception_identity as ri; print(ri.derive_candidate_identity('.'))" 2>&1 | tail -1
cat .prflow/tmp/ckout-final.json

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment 5174592583 --reaction hooray 2>&1 | tail -2
rm -f .prflow/tmp/implement-active-1243 .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1243.md 2>/dev/null
echo "cleanup done"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
